### Wrapping Up a Ragged-Edge Journey
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/wrapping-up-a-ragged-edge-journey
Passage: Ecclesiastes 12:13-14
Points:
- Solomon closes his honest life journal with a simple and direct summary.
- The core duty of every person is to revere God and obey His commands.
- God will hold everyone accountable by bringing every deed and secret thought to judgment.
- Christ provides the only way to navigate life and stand ready for this reckoning.

### To Study or Not to Study
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/study-or-not-study
Passage: Ecclesiastes 12:11-12
Points:
- The wise sayings of Scripture ultimately originate from God, the one Shepherd.
- Inspired wisdom prods believers toward righteousness like a goad guiding livestock.
- Endless study without seeking real answers leads only to weariness of the flesh.
- Scripture serves as our final authority to show us how God wants us to live.
